steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"

elements.name: The list shows every vocabulary with its key data

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
a vocabulary "{Alpha}" exists
I open the Vocabulary Management page
I see a row for "{Alpha}" with: actions menu, name, description, current version, status, date created, last updated, creator
the actions menu of "{Alpha}" offers "View vocabulary details" and "Download vocabulary"

elements.name: A failing list request is reported

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
the API fails when the vocabulary list is requested
I open the Vocabulary Management page
I am told that the vocabulary list could not be loaded
I see the details of the error

elements.name: Filter by status and by part of the name

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
a vocabulary "{Alpha}" exists
a vocabulary "{Beta}" exists
vocabulary "{Beta}" is deprecated
I open the Vocabulary Management page
I filter on name "{RUN}"
I see "{Alpha}" and "{Beta}"
I also filter on status "Deprecated"
I see "{Beta}" and not "{Alpha}"
I clear the name filter
every row shows status "Deprecated"

elements.name: Sort by clicking a column header

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
a vocabulary "{Bravo}" exists
a vocabulary "{Alpha}" exists
I open the Vocabulary Management page filtered on name "{RUN}"
I click the "Name" column header
the rows are ordered by name
I click the "Name" column header again
the rows are ordered by name in the opposite direction

elements.name: Deprecated vocabularies carry a warning in the list

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
a vocabulary "{Alpha}" exists
vocabulary "{Alpha}" is deprecated
I open the Vocabulary Management page
the row of "{Alpha}" shows a clear deprecation warning
I am signed in to the UI as "admin"

elements.name: The history shows all versions in order

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
vocabulary "{Alpha}" has 3 versions
I open the history of "{Alpha}"
I am on the details page of "{Alpha}" with its name in the header
I see 3 versions in chronological order, each with: download action, version number, status, date created, description, change log

elements.name: A deprecated version is labelled and points to the active version

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
vocabulary "{Alpha}" has 2 versions
I open the history of "{Alpha}"
version 1 is labelled "Deprecated" with a clear warning
the warning links to version 2, the latest active version
I open version 1
I see its metadata: version, date created, creator, change log

elements.name: A deprecated version without any active version still shows the warning

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
vocabulary "{Alpha}" has 2 versions
vocabulary "{Alpha}" is deprecated
I open the history of "{Alpha}"
every version shows a clear deprecation warning
no link to an active version is shown

elements.name: Download the newest version

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
vocabulary "{Alpha}" has 2 versions
I open the Vocabulary Management page
I choose the download action for "{Alpha}"
a Turtle file of version 2 is downloaded

elements.name: Download a selected older version

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
vocabulary "{Alpha}" has 2 versions
I open the history of "{Alpha}"
I download version 1
a Turtle file of version 1 is downloaded

name: Vocabulary details, history and download in the UI

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"

elements.name: The creation form asks only for name, description and file

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
I open the Vocabulary Management page
I click "New Vocabulary +"
I see a creation form with the required fields Name, Description and File upload
there is no field for version or change log

elements.name: A valid vocabulary is created and becomes active

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
I create vocabulary "{Alpha}" in the UI from "valid_v1.ttl"
I see a confirmation that syntax and structure validation passed
"{Alpha}" appears in the list with version 1 and status "Active"

elements.name: Validation messages for missing fields and a duplicate name

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
a vocabulary "{Alpha}" exists
I submit the creation form with name "{Alpha}" and no description
I see an error that the description is required
I add a description and submit again
I see an error that the name "{Alpha}" is already used
no vocabulary is created

elements.name: Syntax errors are listed with their location and block the flow

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
I upload "syntax_errors.ttl" in the creation form for "{Alpha}"
validation runs automatically on upload
I see a list of the syntax errors, each with its location
I cannot submit the form until the errors are fixed

elements.name: Semantic errors are reported after syntax validation

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
I create vocabulary "{Alpha}" in the UI from "class_and_property.ttl"
I see a structured report of the semantic errors
"{Alpha}" is not created

elements.name: A new version gets the next number automatically and replaces the active one

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
a vocabulary "{Alpha}" exists
I open the actions menu of "{Alpha}" and click "Update"
the form is pre-filled with the current metadata
there is no field for the version number
I enter a change summary, upload "valid_v2.ttl" and submit
I see a confirmation that version 2 of "{Alpha}" was created
the history of "{Alpha}" shows version 2 "Active" and version 1 "Deprecated"

elements.name: An error during version creation is reported and nothing is created

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
a vocabulary "{Alpha}" exists
the API fails when a new version is created
I submit a new version of "{Alpha}" from "valid_v2.ttl"
I see an error that the operation failed, with advice to retry or contact support
the history of "{Alpha}" shows only version 1

elements.name: Selecting a deprecated version as a reference shows a warning

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
vocabulary "{Alpha}" has 2 versions
a vocabulary "{Beta}" exists
I start a new version of "{Beta}" that references version 1 of "{Alpha}"
I see a warning that version 1 of "{Alpha}" is deprecated
the warning recommends version 2, the latest active version

name: Create a vocabulary and new versions in the UI

elements.name: Deprecate and restore a vocabulary

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
a vocabulary "{Alpha}" exists
I change the status of "{Alpha}" to "Deprecated"
I see a confirmation that the status was updated
the row of "{Alpha}" shows status "Deprecated"
I change the status of "{Alpha}" to "Active"
the row of "{Alpha}" shows status "Active"

elements.name: A failing status change leaves the status unchanged

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "admin"
a vocabulary "{Alpha}" exists
the API fails when a status is changed
I change the status of "{Alpha}" to "Deprecated"
I am told that the status could not be updated
the row of "{Alpha}" still shows status "Active"

elements.name: A viewer does not see the management actions

steps.name: I am signed in to the UI as "viewer"
a vocabulary "{Alpha}" exists
I open the Vocabulary Management page
I see "{Alpha}" in the list
"New Vocabulary +", "Update" and the status change action are not shown

elements.name: Without signing in, access is refused and I am asked to sign in

steps.name: I am not signed in to the UI
I open the Vocabulary Management page
I am asked to sign in

name: Status change and access control in the UI
